_doc: Reference-plate manifest for Silver Maple (Acer saccharinum). Stage-0 source list; binaries download in Stage-1 ingest (downloaded:false). Jacob ratifies identification (ratified:false).
identityNotes: Deeply cut, sharply pointed lobes with very deep U-sinuses and a VIVID silvery-white underside — the whole canopy flashes silver in wind (the defining trait). Often weak-wooded, ascending-then-arching limbs.

plates.caption: Broad spreading crown; deeply lobed leaves with silver undersides catching light.
Pale yellow autumn foliage (less vivid than sugar/red maple).
Mature shaggy grey-to-reddish-brown peeling bark strips.
